title: FoldJAX foldjax_run.json
description: The manifest one finished prediction writes at <run>/foldjax_run.json: what ran (model, input and its digest, weights identity, seeds and their source, sampling, options, padding), what it cost, which inputs the model never read, and every sample's structure with its SHA-256 and native scores. Its presence means the run finished. `schema` (integer) versions the fields that make a run safe to resume; `schema_version` versions this published contract. Compatibility: schema_version is MAJOR.MINOR. A minor version only adds optional fields, so a reader for 1.x accepts any 1.y and ignores fields it does not know; removing, renaming or reinterpreting a field requires a new major version. Per-sample `scores` are native and model-specific; the common names and scales are in each sample's confidence.json `summary`. Common fields standardize names and numerical scales. They retain model-specific definitions and calibration and do not establish comparable accuracy probabilities or authorize pooled cross-model ranking.

foldjax_source.description: Where the FoldJAX that wrote this run came from: its package version, and `git describe --always --dirty` of the checkout it was imported from, or null for an installed wheel or when git is unavailable. Optional: absent from manifests written before it existed.

source.description: Present when the run is one job of a multi-job file: path is then the generated single-job document, and this is the file the caller wrote and the job's 0-based index and name in it.

ignored_msas.description: Alignments the common job named that the native input left out, or a native OpenDDE job's RNA unpairedMsaPath that use_rna_msa=false drops; null when the input was other native input (not inspected).

ignored_templates.description: Templates the common job named that the native input left out, or a native OpenDDE job's templatesPath that use_template=false drops; null when the input was other native input (not inspected).

ignored_constraints.description: Constraints the backend never reads (OpenDDE) and that the run went without: a native job's constraint, or a common job's pocket and contact constraints; null where the backend has no such gate. Optional: absent from manifests written before it existed.

constraints.description: A common job's pocket and contact constraints as the native input carries them: a pocket's binder chain and [chain, residue] contacts, or a contact's token1 and token2 ([chain, residue] each); the max_distance (angstrom) the model runs at, and max_distance_source, 'job' or 'upstream' (the model's own default when the job omitted it). null for native input. Optional: absent from manifests written before it existed.

seed_source.description: Where the seeds came from: the caller, the model's fixed upstream default, a draw, the native job's modelSeeds, or FoldJAX's own default.

templates.description: The template-search policy: none, auto, or required (search, and fail the run rather than fold without). Optional: absent from manifests written before it existed, which ran with none.

template_max_date.description: The caller's release-date cutoff for searched templates (YYYY-MM-DD), or null for the model's released default. Optional.

template_dir.description: A private folder of mmCIF files searched for templates instead of the PDB: its resolved path, file count and a SHA-256 over every file's name and content; null when none. Optional.

msa_pairing.description: How a searched alignment paired the complex: requested (model, greedy, complete, none), resolved (greedy, complete, per_chain, none), the ColabFold mode, and paired_by (row, species or null: how the model joins chains' rows; species re-pairs by the UniProt species in each header, which ColabFold headers lack, so no row beyond the query is paired, as AlphaFold 3's per-chain alignment and OpenDDE's default do upstream; absent from older manifests); null when nothing was searched. Optional: absent before it existed, which ran with model.

msa_stats.description: Each chain's alignment as the model reads it: per chain, unpaired_msa and paired_msa records with depth (rows, query included) and neff (effective sequences at 80% identity, the definition alongside); null for native input. Optional.

preset.description: The named sampling preset the run used (name, the sampling it set, and the publisher's source), or null. Optional.

template_search.description: One record per protein entity templates=auto searched: chains, hit source, structure source, the date cutoff applied and where it comes from, the selection rule, the hits file, and each template kept (PDB id, author and label chain, release date, e-value, mmCIF path) or the error that left the chain without templates; null when no search was asked for. Optional.

confidence_arrays.description: The run's per-sample confidence_full.npz record (file, schema_version, samples, arrays, unavailable), or null when none was written.
Where a sample's confidence arrays (PAE, chain-pair matrices, per-token or per-atom pLDDT) are, which are present, and why others are unavailable. Written by foldjax.confidence_arrays.

best.description: This model's top-ranked sample by the score it ranks with, within this run. Not an accuracy claim and never a cross-model pick.
